newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian police smash biggest-ever drug lab.
newsitem.headline: Colombian police smash biggest-ever drug lab.

text.p: Police are dismantling the biggest drug laboratory ever discovered in Colombia, authorities said on Thursday.
National Police chief Gen. Rosso Jose Serrano said 8.5 tons of cocaine were seized in a raid that began early on Wednesday on the clandestine factory in a remote jungle-covered southeastern area.
It was capable of producing up to 50 tons of cocaine a month, he said.
"It's bigger even than Tranquilandia," Serrano told Reuters, referring to another big drug lab discovered earlier.
"Oceans full of cocaine were coming out of this place to supply international markets," Serrano added in a telephone interview.
He said 100 crack anti-narcotics police raided the 1.5 square mile (four sq km) factory in Guaviare province on Wednesday and were still dismantling it on Thursday.
No arrests were made, but police seized six helicopters, three speedboats and one airplane during the raid, Serrano said.
